in_sanskrit.name: मिनाक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Minakshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Minaksi', which means 'Goddess of Eyes'. In Hindu mythology, Minakshi is depicted as a beautiful goddess with three eyes, two on her face and one on her forehead. She is also known as 'Sundareswara' or 'The Beautiful One', and is the wife of Lord Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Minakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Minakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Minakshi is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘mīnā’ (fish) and ‘akṣi’ (eye). In Hindu mythology, Goddess Parvati created the fish-eyed Goddess Minakshi to help Arjuna in the great battle of Mahabharata. Minakshi is believed to be the embodiment of wisdom, beauty, and the power of love. She is also known as ‘Sundaresvara Kameshwari’, the goddess of love and desire.
